headline: Vet-formulated nutrition for your older dog
body: Every ingredient is listed clearly so you know exactly what goes into your family member's bowl. Keep them active and comfortable with our grain-free senior recipe delivered monthly.
rationale: This ad speaks directly to the Pet Parent who views their dog as a family member and demands clear ingredient labels. It uses the exact requested messaging preferences and steers clear of generic or cheap framing, matching their willingness to pay for high quality.
